instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use ONLY React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing layouts, relying on Shadcn purely for interactive components (dialogs, inputs, forms).
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a luxury, high-end, monochrome aesthetic. Strict use of black, white, and varying opacities of white for borders and text.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use `lucide-react` for icons, particularly for the bottom-right AI Chat floating trigger and chat interface elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The AI Chat should be implemented as a state-driven fixed overlay that toggles when the floating button or Hero CTA is clicked.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: The AI Chat must connect to `http://localhost:5678/webhook/real-estate-assistant` to POST user queries. Implement a simulated loading state while waiting for the response. Provide empty state and error state.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Typography: Use `Cormorant Garamond` (Google Font) for headings and `Manrope` (Google Font) for body. Ensure these are imported via Google Fonts in `index.html` or `index.css`.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Use `framer-motion` for page reveal animations and scroll-triggered fade-ups. Add subtle parallax to the hero image.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements, including chat trigger (`data-testid="chat-trigger"`), chat input (`data-testid="chat-input"`), send button (`data-testid="chat-send-button"`), and hero cta (`data-testid="hero-chat-cta"`).
instructions_to_main_agent.9: The design must feel cinematic: high contrast, elegant typography, generous spacing, thin 1px borders, and striking photography.
instructions_to_main_agent.10: For the chat UI, ensure high contrast. The bot's message bubble should be dark gray (#1a1a1a) and the user's message bubble should be white with black text.
instructions_to_main_agent.11: Make sure to configure Tailwind config extending fontFamily with cormorant and manrope. Example: `fontFamily: { serif: ['Cormorant Garamond', 'serif'], sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'] }`
